light:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape 3:2 hero artwork of a real, cohesive premium architectural model, for a NAS.IO hackathon learning to turn advertising into community event attendance.
Primary request: "The Invitation Studio", a beautiful miniature museum exhibit illustrating campaign → compelling event invitation → gathering. Sophisticated editorial product photograph, exceptionally tactile and carefully made, cinematic soft lighting.
Composition: one low rounded warm ivory platform. Centre-back, a dominant tall upright event landing-page sculpture in a thick rounded midnight-green frame with a thin brushed brass inner bezel, approximately 3.3 units tall by 2.2 wide. Its ivory face contains a relief image of an amber sun above terracotta dunes, two elegant embossed headline lines, three fine description lines, and a prominent wide amber call-to-action button near the bottom. Left foreground: three small physical advertising cards in a gently fanned brass stand, each with a miniature ochre image and abstract text bars, like designed editorial postcards. Right: a precisely crafted miniature semicircular amphitheatre with three concentric ivory steps, twelve small curved terracotta upholstered seats facing a little circular golden stage and slim microphone stand. A graceful golden pathway ribbon physically flows from the large amber button down onto the platform and sweeps right into the auditorium. Subtle brass edge details, fine page edges, fluted instrument-style side trims, beautifully bevelled edges. Balanced asymmetric composition, central page is hero, unmistakable event invitation and community gathering story.
Materials: warm matte porcelain, eggshell paper, brushed champagne brass, soft terracotta upholstery, deep petrol enamel. Warm ivory seamless studio backdrop, realistic ambient occlusion, soft broad shadows, subtle grazing light revealing textures. View from front and slightly above at 20 degrees, see stage and seats without overhead plan view, 70mm lens. Occupy 82% of image with complete sculpture and generous 7% margins.
No text, letters, numbers, watermarks, charts, people, campfire, literal funnel cone, floating holograms or giant surrounding pedestal. This must feel like a desirable handcrafted exhibition object, not blocky low-poly or clip art.
dark: Use case: lighting-weather. Create the dark studio edition of this exact Invitation Studio sculpture. Preserve all objects, their arrangement, geometry, green and brass event-page frame, sun-and-dune relief, ivory campaign cards, golden CTA button and connecting pathway, terracotta auditorium seats and microphone. Only change the seamless studio backdrop and floor to rich warm charcoal #202320 with a soft warm key light and subtle rim light. Ivory remains luminous, rich green frame readable, brass satin rather than glaring yellow. Keep the entire object in frame with comfortable margins and 3:2 landscape composition. No words or numbers, no added objects, no stars, no neon effects, no watermark.
